The second pathway connects Napyradiomycin B3 to Annexin A1, which is targeted by a complex compound and also leads to HEp-2. These findings suggest that Napyradiomycin B3 may exert its effects through diverse molecular mechanisms, potentially involving lipid metabolism and cell signaling pathways. The evidence supports a role for Napyradiomycin B3 in modulating cellular functions that are relevant to HEp-2, though the exact mechanism of action remains to be fully elucidated.
